subject: Literature
title: Shakespeare on Film
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Shakespeare on Film.

hook.text: The first Shakespeare film was made in 1899, and over four hundred film adaptations have followed since.

buildup.text: Laurence Olivier, Kenneth Branagh, and Baz Luhrmann each reinvented Shakespeare for their generation's screen.

discovery.text: Akira Kurosawa adapted Macbeth and King Lear into Japanese samurai films that are now considered masterpieces.

twist.text: Disney's The Lion King is essentially Hamlet with lions, yet most viewers never realize the connection.

climax.text: Shakespeare's plays survive because they adapt effortlessly to every medium, era, and cultural context.

punchline.text: Hamlet became a lion and nobody even noticed.

quiz.question: Which Disney film is essentially an adaptation of Hamlet?
